onboarding.title: Vault Keeper
onboarding.subtitle: Hi! I am your financial Tamagotchi. My health (HP) directly depends on how well you stick to your daily budget. Don't let me get knocked out.
onboarding.currencySub: Your limit, expenses and coins will be counted in it.
onboarding.limitSub: Set a comfortable daily spending amount — I'll calculate my health from it.
onboarding.testTitle: Let's see how I react to spending
onboarding.testBody: Tap «Add expense» and enter a test purchase of {{amount}} (e.g. Coffee).
onboarding.damageTitle: See? Every purchase takes a part of my HP.
onboarding.damageFoot: Your HP is {{hp}}% now. Spend more than the daily limit — I get knocked out and the day streak resets.
onboarding.ruleBody: Expenses cannot be deleted or edited — entries are written in ink. Typed the wrong amount? Adjust your income in the profile.
onboarding.pauseBody: When you want an impulse purchase, a 5-second pause kicks in. Cool down and think whether it's worth my health.
onboarding.pauseFoot: Cancel during the pause and the amount goes to «Saved Capital» while your pet's HP stays intact. You can turn the pause off in the profile.
